'''Undersecretary of Commerce''' was a position in the government of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was held by [[Administrator/Legends|Administrator]] [[Mozim]] and after the majority of the government was evacuated during the [[Battle of Argul]], he was the highest-ranking official left behind.
